mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a short-term sell-off in equities over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases where both series show growth.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth, manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth rate exceeds 1.0% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (quarterly) indicates expanding economic activity, driving short-term positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 7.0% signals a tight labor market, leading to sustained positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as wage growth supports consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate and stable inflation (CPI) indicates accommodative monetary policy without inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases where FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 100 signals robust manufacturing output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as supply chain pressures ease.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.
